network.storage: fp16 (exact: the training weights are fp16)

candidate_procedure: 1. t = 0: B's body pass (ratings, cadence, venue; values never enter the body) in parallel with Stockfish pass 1 (MultiPV over every legal move, 150,000 nodes, 1 thread, Hash 64 MB cleared, FEN only)

2. as soon as the body is done: B's move head with EVERY value input masked (valued = 0 on all moves, as the masked-values training rows) -> B's top 3 (ties: the lower legal-move index first, numpy stable argsort)
3. candidates = that top 3 + Stockfish's top 2 at pass 1, legal, no duplicate, in this order (toby2.v2_candidates)

4. pass 2: MultiPV over the candidates (if >= 2), 250,000 nodes, Hash cleared; started on a second single-thread Stockfish as soon as the top 3 is known, kept only if the final candidate list equals the top 3, else recomputed (same values either way: each search starts from a cleared hash)
5. values = pass 1's, replaced by pass 2's on the candidates; B's heads on them -> distribution and W/D/L
candidates_rule: sealed protocol 11.2 gate 9 (report v7_toby2_final_ab.md section 8: Network). The sealed scoring must replicate candidate_procedure exactly (the engine's procedure, not the dev check's)

values.rule: Stockfish values given on every position (sealed protocol 1.4), classical below 2200 included
values.recipe: toby_uci.sf_v2 = toby2.Toby2Search: Stockfish 19, MultiPV over every legal move at V2_BASE = 150,000 nodes, then MultiPV over the candidates (candidate source top 3 + Stockfish's top 2, toby_uci.v2_candidates order) at V2_EXT = 250,000 nodes; 1 thread, Hash 64 MB cleared before every search, FEN only, deepest completed iteration
values.scored_path: analysis (no time limit: values always computed)

clock.inputs: Time Control option = the game's cadence (Classical / Rapid / Blitz), venue OTB; base, increment and both clocks given as unknown (options Base Time 0, Increment -1)

position_evaluation: Network (B's W/D/L head); Toby 1.0's line M only by rule 6.5
gpu_only: offered only when an NVIDIA GPU and lc0 pass the probe; otherwise Toby 2 Standard answers (said once, in the path line)

cuda.note: the engine's default GPU path for B (TOBY2_FP16 unset)

head_rule.rule: sealed protocol 6.3 (rapid / blitz default written after decisions.json); option Leela Head = On / Off forces

leela.lc0_sha256_rule: per platform; null = not pinned there (the Windows package's official CUDA build, hash written by its build), the self-check still decides
leela.position: FEN only (leela_feats.lc0_fen: move number 1), tree reset before each search
leela.gpu: any NVIDIA card whose lc0 passes the self-check below (no compute-capability list); the sealed test runs on A40

selfcheck.what: lc0 self-check of Toby 2 Accurate: 3 fixed dev positions and their stored training features (A40, lc0 0.32.1 + BT3, 1,024 nodes, cuda-fp16) of the visited moves; a card passes if, on every position, the search completes, its most visited move is the stored one, max |d visit share| <= tolerance over the legal moves and |d root WL| <= tolerance
selfcheck.noise_reference: A40, the engine's own lc0 path (one process), 5 searches per position: worst max |d share| against the stored features on the 3 chosen positions <= 0.0083; over 60 random dev positions median 0.0361, p95 0.1001
selfcheck.tolerance_reason: share: ~12x the worst engine-path noise on these positions (0.0083 over 5 A40 runs, 0.016 in a later run); root WL: the A40 engine path reached 0.046 once, so 0.15 leaves room for another card's fp16 numerics; a broken backend or network fails by far

leela.on_failure: probe or self-check failed: Toby 2 Standard answers for the session (said once, path line); a later failed search: said, that move answered by B with Stockfish values (head off), lc0 not relaunched

variants.classical: T2A (head on); A-FB = Leela Head Off
variants.rapid_blitz: B-rb (head off) or H-rb (head on), rule 6.3

blunder_penalty.rule: p'(m) proportional to p(m) exp(-beta(E) L(m)); L = ES(E, best value) - ES(E, v(m)) from the engine's Stockfish values (CLAUDE.md ES); l0 = 0; beta(E) = monotone PCHIP through (knots_E, knots_beta), flat outside the knots, g = 1 (no phase factor); W/D/L untouched; only with values; group classical only (rapid / blitz: no penalty)
blunder_penalty.fit: nn/pass3/fit_penalty.py --objective ll, even dev games, candidate g = 1 (T2A)
